选择哪些应用以跑马灯形式显示: Choose which apps appear as tickers
系统应用和 OpenTicker 自身始终不会以跑马灯显示。所有内容都留在你的设: System apps and OpenTicker itself are always hidden from the ticker. Everything stays on your device.
调节每个跑马灯的动效与停顿: Tune how every ticker moves and rests
长消息在单行中滑过的速度。: How fast long messages glide across a single line.
主题播放进场与退场的速度。觉得卡片太慢就调高，太快就调低。: How fast the theme plays its entrance and exit. Turn it up if a card feels too slow, down if it is too quick.
跑马灯滑走前停留的时长。速度越快时间越短。: How long a ticker stays before it slides away. Faster speeds shorten it.
窄一些的跑马灯更不显眼，全宽能显示更多文字。: Narrower tickers feel more ambient; full width fits more text.
跑马灯保持在同一行滑过，直到完整显示。内容不会被截断，也不会堆在你的屏幕上。: Tickers stay on one line and glide past until the full message has been shown. Nothing gets truncated, nothing gets stacked on top of your screen.
读取通知所必需。OpenTicker 绝不会上传。: Required to read notifications. OpenTicker never uploads them.
让跑马灯悬浮在游戏、视频等一切内容之上。: Lets tickers float above games, video and everything else.
没有这项设置三星会关闭后台应用，跑马灯将不再出现。: Samsung kills background apps without this - tickers would stop arriving.
让 OpenTicker 在跑马灯之后于通知栏保留一条镜像记录。: Lets OpenTicker keep one mirrored entry in the shade after the ticker.
负值让跑马灯上移，正值让它下移。默认是 +10 dp。: Negative values raise the ticker, positive values lower it. The default is +10 dp.
OpenTicker 通过 Android 的通知监听服务在本机读取通知。: OpenTicker reads notifications locally through Android's notification listener.
只有你在“应用”页允许的应用才能进入跑马灯。: Only apps you allow in the Apps tab can reach the ticker.
选中的样式从顶部滑入，然后自行离开。: The chosen style glides in at the top, then leaves on its own.
你的通知只在本机处理，绝不上传、出售或用于广告。OpenTicker 并不会取代: Your notifications are processed on this device and never uploaded, sold or used for ads. OpenTicker does not replace Android's notification shade - it is simply a calmer way to see what arrived.
适用于所有主题的消息文字。默认是 13 sp。: Applies to the message text in every theme. The default is 13 sp.
选择应用使用的语言。: Choose the language the app speaks.
OpenTicker 在你的设备上读取通知，并悬浮在其他应用之上。不会上传，也不: OpenTicker reads notifications on your device and floats them over other apps. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is collected.
长消息在单行中滑过，直到完整显示。: Long messages glide past in one line until they've been shown in full.
发送者、消息、头像与行数。: Sender, message, avatar and line count.
指针、金色饰边、屏幕网纹、线条与调谐动效。: Needle, gold trim, screen mesh, lines and tuning-in motion.
章鱼配色、行数、预览类型与礁石动效。: Octopus colour, lines, preview kinds and reef motion.
背景、消息气泡、按钮、行数与运动。: Background, message bubble, buttons, lines and movement.
夜空、配色、消息行数与波纹玻璃按钮。: Night sky, colour, message lines and wavy glass buttons.
实时改变预览，并应用到浮动通知。: Changes preview live and apply to the floating notification.
流动的光与动态按钮边框: Flowing lights and the animated button border
指针扫动、屏幕辉光、日出与调谐旋钮: Needle sweep, screen glow, sunburst and ring dial-in
光芒、水波、焦散、鱼群与摇曳海藻: God rays, ambient bubbles, caustics, fish and swaying kelp
在卡片中使用来源应用的图标: Use the source app icon in the card
跑马灯像新闻滚动条一样播放消息。折行模式最多显示 3 行，之后省略。: Ticker runs the message like a news line. Wrapped modes show up to 3 lines, then ellipsize.
预览前缀、动效、消息行数与按钮大小，这些主题会保留自己的配色。: Preview with, motion, message lines and the button size - these themes keep their designed palette.
与真实一致：消息显示 回复 / 已读 / 静音，来电显示 接听 / 拒绝，音乐显: Mirrors the real thing: a message shows Reply / Read / Mute, a call shows Answer / Reject, music shows transport controls - and a notification with no actions gets a blank dock.
发送者、时钟、消息与按钮文字的颜色，玻璃主题保留自己的宝石色调。: The colour of the sender, the clock, the message and the button labels - the glass keeps its own jewel tones.
星星、扫描线、天气、光束等动态: Stars, scanlines, weather, light rays and other motion
一行更薄，三行更高。跑马灯像新闻滚动条一样播放消息。: One line = thinner card, three lines = taller card. Ticker runs the message like a news line.
只缩放按钮栏，卡片、图形与文字保持不变。: Scales the dock buttons only - the card, artwork and text stay put.
你的图片只保存在本机。位置与缩放会应用到浮动通知。: Your image stays on this device. Position and scale apply to the floating notification.
请允许“显示在其他应用上层”，跑马灯才能悬浮: Allow “Display over other apps” so tickers can float
